# Public Wizard OS release metadata

This directory publishes only the installer’s release metadata. The canonical Wizard OS specification repository remains private; no source checkout, credentials or owner configuration is mirrored here.

`get.sh` reads `stable` (or `latest` on a box whose owner chose the latest channel), then `<version>.json`. `WIZARD_RELEASE_BASE` still supports an explicitly chosen alternate mirror or local release directory.

## Channels (wizard-os DECISIONS #75)

- `latest`: every release as soon as it is cut. Mirror it with each new release JSON.
- `stable`: only releases promoted with wizard-os `tools/promote_stable.py`, i.e. 72 hours on latest plus a passed upgrade test, recorded in `promotions/<version>.json`. A fix or feature release with a passed upgrade test may skip the 72 hours (`fast_track` in its record, wizard-os DECISIONS #82 and #93); `wam/updates.py` applies the same gate as the tool. Mirror the record together with the pointer.

Never point `stable` at a release without its promotion record: `tests/test_release_channels.py` fails, and boxes on Automatic refuse to install it. 0.3.25 is grandfathered as the first stable.

## stable 0.3.63

Promoted under DECISIONS #82/#93 (fast-track, classification **fix**). Stable 0.3.61 with only the two AI connection apps changed: ChatGPT chatgpt-connection f87d5dd → 476d771 (0.2.4: the same accounts page as Claude, sign-in through the agent, "Device code sign-in for Codex" named up front) and Claude claude-connection eb434ae → d0b59dd (0.2.6: no Claude Code fallback on alongside boxes, one row per account); both report an unreachable agent with Retry and answer `/api/connection` with `unreachable` instead of an empty inventory (wizard-app-store #32). Installed upgrade 0.3.61 → 0.3.63 passed on the demo box through `os.sh` with `WIZARD_STRICT=1`: pinned, 0 failed checks, Hermes files unchanged, doctor 0 FAIL, Home shows ChatGPT with usage. Canonical evidence: wizard-os/docs/acceptance/promote-0.3.63.md (wizard-os #259 cut, #261 promotion). Rollback: point `stable` back at 0.3.61.

## 0.3.104 provenance clarification

The "Merged since" list in the `about` text of the immutable `0.3.104.json` is incomplete; treat it as highlights rather than a complete inventory. The App Manager source pin moves from `525e9d3d211b16d1fcc667cf5865c5776aae369f` (also selected by 0.3.103) to `17c8d9cdfb521290bc65f7bad4726bfd9abf1443`: the [complete pinned source comparison](https://github.com/humanitylabs-org/wizard-app-manager/compare/525e9d3d211b16d1fcc667cf5865c5776aae369f...17c8d9cdfb521290bc65f7bad4726bfd9abf1443) is authoritative for the intervening changes.

The highlights omit, among others, #418 (preserve working app links), #419/#423 (run the box's own App Manager from the builder bundle), #426 (private build contexts), #427 (alternative providers in doctor), #428–#430 (builder feedback, migration and restore), #432 (home-screen capability metadata), and #440 (large comparisons in About). This clarification changes no source or image pin, channel, default, switch or installed state. Preserve the published manifest byte-for-byte; SHA256 remains `d403b97a48310a4df7f478f264c14783414a3ea2b5fe731d355beb035acb118f`.

## 0.3.134 provenance

Canonical: wizard-os releases/0.3.134.json (humanitylabs-org/wizard-os#474). SHA256: `1ae716ae8e360a199cf731fd7981aacd3c45d05bb7a3aa108a7e43add8e23b4c`.
Stable 0.3.102 with only the Troubleshooter pin moved, 3e56f66d -> 9088a254 (humanitylabs-org/wizard-troubleshooter main, #24-#42): the Troubleshooter gets a locked-out box back on its own: a bounded forced Hermes restart when a drain hangs, Restart now, crash-loop handoff, the reply keeper check, owner-approved repair plans on by default, and the page watches itself. Every other pin is exactly 0.3.102. Cut for Stable so fresh installs get it; Latest gets the same pin in the next release.
Channel: on latest only.

## 0.3.140 provenance

Canonical: wizard-os releases/0.3.140.json (humanitylabs-org/wizard-os#482). SHA256: `07cda908d8a92df9340accabfc2f6ff15b43891ad11a7e5d3dc4232023bfa9c8`.
Stable 0.3.134 with only the App Manager moved, 525e9d3d -> 9f793620, and its image to the published main image v4.10.2-wizard.1052-17c8d9c (source_commit 17c8d9cd + image_inputs, the image Latest already runs). Brings humanitylabs-org/wizard-app-manager#542 (James, 9 Nov 2026): the Troubleshooter guardian repairs a broken link by itself on fresh installs and on boxes that never chose otherwise; `wam troubleshooter --report-only` keeps it report-only across updates, `--act` turns repairs back on. Stable candidate; every other pin exactly 0.3.134.
Correction: the `components.wizard-troubleshooter.note` carried unchanged from 0.3.134 in 0.3.139, 0.3.140 and 0.3.141 still says the guardian timer is installed "report-only". From App Manager 9f793620 on that is out of date: `wam troubleshooter` writes GUARDIAN_ACT=1 unless the owner chose report-only. Published release files are immutable, so the correction is recorded here.
Channel: on latest only (until promoted).

Fix-only: #719 backports humanitylabs-org/wizard-app-manager#712 (big app updates are sent once, get a 30-minute limit, and wam waits for the real result instead of starting or rolling back over a running update) and #716 (Store Start for an app an update left stopped; no second update on top of a running one; an update that leaves the app stopped says failed), both for #711. Every other pin is exactly 0.3.143.

## 0.3.310 provenance

Canonical: wizard-os releases/0.3.310.json (humanitylabs-org/wizard-os#754, Refs humanitylabs-org/wizard-app-manager#807). SHA256: `3a9cb2f9774de137d8d2e8a0b592629eb0f38eb7dc6a57a770d8bc60129d4859`.
Latest 0.3.309 with the Claude and ChatGPT connection apps moved to the packages that carry the private-first sign-in (wizard-app-store #78): claude-connection #24 (Claude 0.2.24, engine wizard-claude:0.2.26) and chatgpt-connection #20 (ChatGPT 0.2.20, engine wizard-chatgpt:0.2.21). On a box with private first on, connecting Claude or ChatGPT signs in the separate standard agent and never touches the private agent (wizard-os spec/AGENTS.md section 10, DECISIONS #115). Refs humanitylabs-org/wizard-app-manager#807. Every component, image and other default app is unchanged from 0.3.309.
Channel: on latest only.
